[[File:Red dragon face.png|left|92px]]
'''Red dragons''' are the second strongest [[chromatic dragons]]. They primarily attack using a [[Fire Bolt]] spell, but as with all dragons, they can use a magic-based dragonfire attack. They also use melee if the player gets within melee range. The dragonbreath attack can hit from a distance as well as up close, so an [[anti-dragon shield]], the [[Protect from Magic]] prayer, or an [[antifire]] potion are essential when fighting them as they can otherwise hit over 1500. Money can be made by selling their drops. Collecting the hides and bones makes each kill worth approximately {{formatnum:{{#expr:{{GEPrice|Dragon bones|n}} + {{GEPrice|Red dragonhide|n}} round 0}}}} [[coins]].

If assigned red dragons as a [[slayer]] task, [[baby red dragon]]s may be killed as an alternative.

==Strategy==
As with all dragons, protection from their [[dragonfire]] is required. The following can be combined to provide full dragonfire protection:
*An [[anti-dragon shield]] or [[dragonfire shield|dragonfire shield (melee)]], [[dragonfire deflector|deflector (ranged)]], or [[dragonfire ward|ward (magic)]] (DFS) with an [[antifire potion]]
*An anti-dragon shield or DFS with the [[protect from magic]] prayer or [[deflect magic]] [[Ancient curses|curse]]
*Protect from/deflect magic and antifire potion

Alternatively, a [[super antifire (4)|super antifire]] potion provides complete immunity to dragonfire.

The dragons are weakest to bolts, so Ranged is the most effective style. Melee is not recommended without high combat stats and equipment.
